mapper.select: SELECT id, category, option_code, option_label, sort_order, enabled, remark, created_at, updated_at FROM biz_dropdown_option WHERE category = #{category} AND enabled = 1 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
SELECT DISTINCT category FROM biz_dropdown_option WHERE enabled = 1 ORDER BY category ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_dropdown_option(category, option_code, option_label, sort_order, enabled, remark) VALUES (#{category}, #{optionCode}, #{optionLabel}, #{sortOrder}, #{enabled}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_dropdown_option SET category = #{category}, option_code = #{optionCode}, option_label = #{optionLabel}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, enabled = #{enabled}, remark = #{remark}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id}
